hero.title: SBVR Agricultural College
hero.summary: SBVR Agricultural College is an ANGRAU-affiliated college at Badvel in Andhra Pradesh. Established for the 2016–17 period under Badvel & Sidhout Higher Education Committee, it combines agricultural classroom teaching with farm learning. The official academics page describes Intermediate and diploma entry routes.

overview.heading: Agriculture learning at Badvel
paragraphs: SBVR Agricultural College is part of the institutions promoted by Badvel & Sidhout Higher Education Committee. Established for the 2016–17 period, it is located in Badvel, YSR Kadapa district, and affiliated to Acharya N. G. Ranga Agricultural University.

The college describes departmental laboratories and a separate agricultural farm, with practical work connecting scientific subjects to cultivation. Its material also identifies experiential learning and village-based RAWEP. These give applicants concrete areas to inspect: the crop assignments students undertake, how fieldwork is assessed, and the current training calendar. Admission enquiries should also confirm the applicable Intermediate or diploma route and the sanctioned entry-year seat allocation.

programmes.name: B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture
programmes.summary: A four-year B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture. The official academics page describes science-based Intermediate entry through EAPCET and an ANGRAU agriculture-diploma route through AGRICET.
programmes.eligibility: 2026–27 BiPC route: Intermediate/equivalent with Physical and Biological/Natural Sciences; eligible ANGRAU diploma categories are separately listed.
programmes.admission_route: 2026 AP EAPCET rank and ANGRAU counselling for this BiPC route.

admissions.heading: Planning an application to SBVR
admissions.intro: SBVR’s academic page explains two entry routes. Applicants should check the current ANGRAU/state notification for exact eligibility, diploma equivalence, seat categories and counselling dates rather than use the page’s undated seat headline. For SBVR Agricultural College, the applicable ANGRAU counselling route now has a revised 30 October 2026 notice: registered candidates follow the stated November rank/category session and check the university’s live seat position. Being called does not guarantee admission.
eligibility_points: The Intermediate route lists Physical Sciences and Biological or Natural Sciences.
The diploma route specifically identifies a two-year Diploma in Agriculture from ANGRAU and AGRICET.

campus.heading: Laboratory learning and an agricultural farm
campus.intro: The college describes departmental laboratories, a library with digital resources and agricultural land for practical work. The homepage also mentions experiential units and RAWEP village placements; detailed current participation requirements should be requested from the college.

facilities.description: The campus and academic material describe laboratories serving agricultural disciplines.

facilities.description: The campus page describes library and digital learning resources.

facilities.name: Boys’ and girls’ hostels
facilities.description: The campus page reports accommodation for 200 boys and 200 girls, with single, double, triple and six-occupant room options. It describes reading and television rooms, drinking-water purification, dining and laundry facilities. Published capacity is not a live vacancy count.

facilities.name: Campus health centre and banking
facilities.description: SBVR describes a basic health centre and an arrangement with Sri Divya Hospital in Badvel for advanced emergencies. The page also identifies an on-campus Bank of Baroda banking/ATM facility.

facilities.name: SC/ST student support and anti-ragging
facilities.description: The college describes an SC/ST Cell that discusses scholarship and hostel concerns, alongside an institutional anti-ragging committee. Scholarship assistance should be distinguished from an approved award or a published fee-reimbursement entitlement.

faqs.question: Which university is SBVR affiliated to?

faqs.question: What entry examinations are described?
faqs.answer: The college academic page describes EAPCET for Intermediate applicants and AGRICET for its specified diploma route.

faqs.question: What diploma does the college mention?
faqs.answer: It refers specifically to the two-year Diploma in Agriculture from ANGRAU, together with SSC and AGRICET. Current equivalence should be checked with the university.

faqs.question: Why is no current intake stated here?
faqs.answer: The college site, ANGRAU directory and ICAR audit show different figures. A current sanctioned seat matrix is required to resolve the difference.
